name: Antelope Valley of the California High Desert

known.article: Antelope Valley of the California High Desert AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Antelope Valley of the California High Desert AVA"

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A high desert California AVA across southern Kern County and northeastern Los Angeles County, circling the cities of Lancaster and Palmdale.
